description: SCOUT's building rasterizer, ported from SCOUT (urban-toolkit/scout): the Rasterize Buildings node runs SCOUT's convert_raster on a buildings layer and joins the zoom-16 height tiles it writes, the input of SCOUT's Deep Umbra shadow model, into one raster in metres that an Autark map draws.
name: SCOUT Raster Conversion

templates.description: SCOUT's OSM vector to raster: SCOUT's convert_raster draws each building's height into 256 by 256 map tiles at a zoom level, 8-bit gray where 255 is the maximum height, in EPSG:3395. Input: a buildings GeoDataFrame with a column of heights in metres. Output: one RASTER, the tiles side by side, heights in metres, for an Autark map and for Accumulated Shadow (scout.shadow).
templates.label: Rasterize Buildings
